styleLock.direction: clinical-clean supplement suite: pure white studio product truth plus royal-blue gradient evidence panels, calm lifestyle as the emotional layer
styleLock.temperature: neutral-cool studio and panels; natural warm daylight allowed only in lifestyle scenes
styleLock.backgroundSystem: about 40% seamless pure white #FFFFFF for hero and detail; about 40% deep royal-blue gradient info panels #15348E to #236FC1 shared by facts, icons and comparison; about 20% real environments - pale marble #B5B8BC, reflective stone counter, one low-key dark backdrop #3F515F
styleLock.lightingSystem: large top softbox with frontal fill, high-key and shadowless on white with only a soft base shadow; natural window or side-back sun in lifestyle; low-key directional window light with counter reflection for the dark shelf scene
styleLock.surfaceSystem: shadowless white void; light reflective marble or stone counters; no warm wood or fabric surfaces
styleLock.typography: geometric sans-serif; navy #0B1E5C headings on white, all-white type on blue panels, small caps orange #F16E29 eyebrow only, fixed hierarchy heading-subhead-icon label-footnote
styleLock.iconSystem: white thin-line circle icons, crossed-out circle grammar for free-from claims, filled versus hollow navy dots in matrices, symmetric 3x3 or 5-column grids
styleLock.presentationRules: single subject centered at 40-50% occupancy; info panels strictly symmetric; copy never overlaps the product; dosage, ingredients and capsule size come only from supplied product facts; the bottle label must read as the target product in any hand-held scene
noDrift: no warm wood or rustic interiors
no neon or saturated misc colors
no dramatic hard light in lifestyle
no fabricated certifications, rankings or numbers - all claims come from verified facts
dark scene never becomes pure black
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: clinical-clean supplement aesthetic. Pure white seamless hero photography under a large soft top light with only a soft contact shadow, paired with deep royal-blue gradient info panels #15348E to #236FC1 carrying white thin-line circle icon systems, crossed-out circles for free-from claims and navy dot matrices; navy #0B1E5C typography on white, all-white type on blue, one restrained coral-orange #F16E29 accent per image. Calm natural-window-light lifestyle scenes with a generic person, and one low-key reflective-counter scene for depth. Dosage, ingredient and capsule-size figures come only from the supplied product facts; certifications and rankings stay within verified facts.
